title: Sierre-Zinal crowns Florea and Kiriago in a fast and furious Golden Trail World Series battle
claims: The series report calls Sierre-Zinal a race 'widely regarded as the "Cathedral of Trail Running"' and describes the 2026 running as the 53rd edition, a 31 km race with 2,200 m of elevation gain beneath five Alpine peaks rising above 4,000 m.
The same report gives the 2026 women's result as Madalina Florea 2:55:46, Caroline Kimutai second and Morven Goodrum third.
The same report gives the 2026 men's result as Philemon Kiriago 2:26:24, Patrick Kipngeno second and Michael Saoli third, a Run2Gether On Trail podium sweep.
The same report states that Maude Mathys set the women's course record of 2:49:20 in 2019 and Kilian Jornet set the men's course record of 2:25:34 in 2024.
The same report describes Sierre-Zinal as the fifth stop of the 2026 Golden Trail World Series.

verification.note: 2026-11-08 直取 GTWS 赛后报道全文。女子冠军成绩写作 2:55:46，与世界田联的 2:55:44 相差 2 秒；本页并列保留，不裁决。'Cathedral of Trail Running' 是系列赛报道用语，不是赛事规则定义。
